agent_final_answer: The iOS app is the "Recreation.gov Mobile App." It is found on the Recreation.gov Mobile App page (reached via the "Get the App" link in the site footer, URL https://www.recreation.gov/mobile-app), where it is offered for iOS through the "Download on the App Store" button (an Android version is also available via Google Play). The app lets you find and reserve campsites, review location details for your trip, and access information on past and upcoming reservations.
